data.name: TreeDescription
data.value: A tree of selectable items, written by hand or generated from data, with custom item content, levels loaded on demand and items moved with the pointer.

data.name: TreeSettingsDescription
data.value: The settings apply to the trees of the page.

data.name: TreeMultipleDescription
data.value: Off, selecting an item releases the previous one.

data.name: TreeStartExpandedDescription
data.value: Drives the Expanded parameter of its branches.

data.name: TreeDisableItemsDescription
data.value: Archives, certificates, Luxembourg and the cities marked closed can no longer be selected.

data.name: TreeLatencyDescription
data.value: Time taken by the branch loaded on opening.

data.name: TreeFailureDescription
data.value: The branch fails to load; closing and reopening it tries again.

data.name: TreeStaticHint
data.value: Each OmniTreeItem is placed in the markup; its children sit directly inside it.

data.name: TreeDataHint
data.value: Regions, countries and cities come from one list; the last branch is loaded when it is opened.

data.name: TreeCustomHint
data.value: TextContent puts an icon and a remark beside the name; Luxembourg is disabled but keeps its place in the traversal.

data.name: TreeMoveHint
data.value: These sample folders move in this preview only. Drag a document onto a folder; the grid follows the new structure.

data.name: TreeAccountsHint
data.value: Drag an account onto another to file it there: it becomes its child, and the branch it lands on opens.

data.name: SpreadsheetDescription
data.value: A basic spreadsheet: cells named by letters and numbers, formulas, keyboard navigation, a formula bar and a model bound both ways that serialises to JSON.

data.name: SpreadsheetSheetDescription
data.value: What the sheet shows and lets you change.

data.name: SpreadsheetReadOnlyDescription
data.value: Cells can still be selected and read, never changed.

data.name: SpreadsheetFormulaBarDescription
data.value: The active address and what was typed in the cell, editable there too.

data.name: SpreadsheetAddRowsDescription
data.value: A button above the sheet adds a row at the bottom.

data.name: SpreadsheetAddColumnsDescription
data.value: A button above the sheet adds a column on the right.

data.name: SpreadsheetColumnWidthDescription
data.value: Set by the page on its own class, through a variable of the package.

data.name: SpreadsheetDataDescription
data.value: The sheet is a serialisable model bound both ways.

data.name: SpreadsheetJsonDescription
data.value: Shows the model as it would be saved: inputs only, formulas included.

data.name: SpreadsheetMirrorDescription
data.value: A second sheet reads the same model, so an edit in the first shows there at once.

data.name: SpreadsheetHowTo
data.value: Arrows move, typing replaces the cell, Enter or F2 edits it, Enter commits, Escape cancels, Delete empties. Try =SUM(B2:D2), =AVERAGE(B2:B6), =B8/0 or =Z99.

data.name: CollectionsDescription
data.value: Movable cards on a board and searchable log lines.

data.name: DataGridActiveColumnDescription
data.value: Tints a sorted or filtered column, header included.

data.name: DataGridAdvancedDescription
data.value: The grid at full stretch: selection, grouping, editing, frozen columns, aggregates and the filter controls the column header can host.

data.name: DataGridAllowPagingDescription
data.value: Off, every row is on one page.

data.name: DataGridAlwaysShowPagerDescription
data.value: Keeps the pager even when one page is enough.

data.name: DataGridCaseSensitivityDescription
data.value: Whether a filter tells capitals from lower case.

data.name: DataGridColumnResizeHowDescription
data.value: Drag the edge of a title, double-click it to fit, or use the arrow keys on it.

data.name: DataGridColumnsDescription
data.value: Width, frozen column and long titles.

data.name: DataGridDataDescription
data.value: What the grid holds: 240 fictional flights, or nothing, or rows still loading.

data.name: DataGridDescription
data.value: The full grid on 240 fictional flights: paging, sorting, four filter shapes, selection, inline editing, detail rows, grouping, virtualization and presentation.

data.name: DataGridDetailRowsDescription
data.value: A chevron opens a panel under the flight: aircraft, route, seats, arrival.

data.name: DataGridEditColumnDescription
data.value: Adds the pencil that opens a row: status and gate become editable.

data.name: DataGridEditModeDescription
data.value: One row at a time, or several at once.

data.name: DataGridEmptyDataDescription
data.value: Empties the rows to show the empty text.

data.name: DataGridExpandAllDescription
data.value: Adds a header button that opens or closes every detail of the page.

data.name: DataGridExpandModeDescription
data.value: One detail at a time, or several.

data.name: DataGridFilteringSectionDescription
data.value: Click a title to sort (Shift for a second sort), type or pick in the row under the titles to filter.

data.name: DataGridFilteringShapesDescription
data.value: Four filter shapes: text for the flight, suggestions for the airline, ticks for the origin, a list for the destination.

data.name: DataGridFilterModesDescription
data.value: A field, a field with its operator, or two conditions in a panel applied on demand.

data.name: DataGridFixedRowHeightDescription
data.value: Every row takes 44 pixels, overflow clipped.

data.name: DataGridFooterPositionDescription
data.value: The price total under the table, or right below the headers.

data.name: DataGridFreezeNumberDescription
data.value: The first column stays in place while the table scrolls sideways.

data.name: DataGridGroupingDescription
data.value: A button in each title groups the rows by that column.

data.name: DataGridGroupPanelDescription
data.value: Lists the active groupings above the table, each one removable.

data.name: DataGridGroupsExpandedDescription
data.value: Initial state of the group headers.

data.name: DataGridHeaderMenuDescription
data.value: Moves each filter into a menu opened from a funnel in its title.

data.name: DataGridHeaderWrapDescription
data.value: The load factor title is longer than its column: wrap it or cut it.

data.name: DataGridHideMenuOnSelectDescription
data.value: With the header menu: closes it as soon as a value is picked.

data.name: DataGridIgnoreDiacriticsDescription
data.value: Typing zurich finds Zürich, and liege finds Liège.

data.name: DataGridLoadingBarModeDescription
data.value: A sweep from one edge to the other, or a continuous run.

data.name: DataGridLoadingDescription
data.value: Forces the busy state, as while a source is answering.

data.name: DataGridLockCancelledDescription
data.value: RowRender makes them unselectable, not expandable, and struck through.

data.name: DataGridLookSectionDescription
data.value: Density, lines, stripes and the grid's own palette.

data.name: DataGridNumericPagesDescription
data.value: How many page numbers surround the current one; none shows page X of Y.

data.name: DataGridPagerAlignDescription
data.value: Where the pager buttons sit in their row.

data.name: DataGridPagerPositionDescription
data.value: Above the table, below it, or both.

data.name: DataGridPageSizeDescription
data.value: Size of a page; changing it goes back to the first one.

data.name: DataGridPageSizeOptionsDescription
data.value: Lets the reader change the page size from the pager.

data.name: DataGridPagingSectionDescription
data.value: How the rows are cut into pages and how the pager reads.

data.name: DataGridPagingSummaryDescription
data.value: Writes the first and last row shown out of the total.

data.name: DataGridResponsiveDescription
data.value: Below 40 rem, each row is stacked into a labelled card.

data.name: DataGridRowHoverDescription
data.value: Tints the row under the pointer.

data.name: DataGridRowsSectionDescription
data.value: Selection, editing, detail panels and grouping.

data.name: DataGridRunsDescription
data.value: Two grids of pipeline runs: one sorted with a tinted column, one striped with a sticky header and export buttons.

data.name: DataGridSelectionModesDescription
data.value: None, one row, or several with a box in the header that ticks the page.

data.name: DataGridSelectOnRowClickDescription
data.value: A click anywhere on the row ticks it, not only on its check box.

data.name: DataGridShowLoadingBarDescription
data.value: While loading, a bar runs under the headers and the rows stay in place; turned off, a paged grid replaces them with the loading row, a virtualized grid keeps the ones it has.

data.name: DataGridSortingDescription
data.value: Ascending, descending, then back to the natural order.

data.name: DataGridVariantsDescription
data.value: The grid sized to its content, capped, truncated, edited in place, shown as a tree, grouped and made to fill the room left in its frame.

data.name: DataGridVirtualizeDescription
data.value: Renders only the rows on screen and scrolls over all 240; paging, grouping and detail rows step aside.

data.name: DataListAlignDescription
data.value: Where the pager sits in its row.

data.name: DataListAnsiHint
data.value: Terminal output with colour codes, shown as coloured text or with the codes stripped.

data.name: DataListCardsHint
data.value: A list drawn as cards, paged by its own pager, with a Markdown export of the cases.

data.name: DataListDescription
data.value: A templated list fed by a collection or an asynchronous loader, with its own loading, empty and error states, and the standalone pager.

data.name: DataListEmptyDataDescription
data.value: Empties the catalogue to show the empty content.

data.name: DataListFailureDescription
data.value: Load only: the loader throws; the list shows its error content and a retry button.

data.name: DataListFirstLastDescription
data.value: Adds the buttons that jump to either end.

data.name: DataListKanbanHint
data.value: Cards moved between columns with the pointer or the keyboard.

data.name: DataListLatencyDescription
data.value: Load only: time the loader takes, while the loading content shows.

data.name: DataListLogHint
data.value: A processing log with levels, a search and a long error line that wraps instead of being cut.

data.name: DataListNumericPagesDescription
data.value: How many page numbers surround the current one; none shows page X of Y.

data.name: DataListPagerDescription
data.value: OmniPager on its own, driven by the page: it only reports the page asked for.

data.name: DataListPageSizeDescription
data.value: Changing it goes back to the first page.

data.name: DataListPageSizeOptionsDescription
data.value: A list in the pager to change the page size.

data.name: DataListSourceDescription
data.value: Where the items come from, and what happens on the way.

data.name: DataListSourceModeDescription
data.value: Items passes the page directly; Load asks a cancellable asynchronous loader.

data.name: DataListVirtualHint
data.value: Two thousand files in a frame that scrolls itself: only the visible window is rendered.

data.name: DataListVirtualizeDescription
data.value: Renders only the visible items of the whole catalogue; the pager is then hidden.

data.name: VariantsCappedHint
data.value: Three rows stay short, ten thousand scroll under an 18 rem cap while only the visible window is rendered.

data.name: VariantsCasesHint
data.value: The grid in its everyday form, one column of each filter shape and text alignment, and an export bar at the foot.

data.name: VariantsEditHint
data.value: Edit from the pencil or a double click, or from a single click in a cell.

data.name: VariantsFillBoxHint
data.value: Settings above, a grid below that takes the rest of a fixed-height frame; the frame scrolls when the settings leave it nothing.

data.name: VariantsPicturesHint
data.value: The grid stays veiled until the pictures of its first rows have loaded, two seconds at most.

data.name: VariantsPicturesTitle
data.value: Grid veiled until its pictures arrive

data.name: VariantsRunStatusHint
data.value: A status dot per row, a number aligned to the end and one selected run.

data.name: VariantsSizingHint
data.value: Each column takes the width of its widest value. The grid loaded by itself shows its headers under the loading bar; the date columns filter from a single entry or a From and To range.

data.name: VariantsTemplatedHint
data.value: Every column has a template and the rows arrive after the first render: the columns take the width of the cells that arrive.

data.name: VariantsTreeHint
data.value: An income statement whose categories carry sub-totals; the buttons open, close and export the whole tree.

data.name: VariantsTruncationHint
data.value: A long value is cut with an ellipsis, whole in its tooltip; in a narrow frame the columns share what is left.
